classification.difficultyReason: Calculate and combine earnings at normal, time-and-a-half and double-time rates.

content.prompt: A job has a normal working hours pay rate of \$11.50 per hour. Calculate the pay for 9 hours at normal pay, 3 hours at time and a half, and 2 hours at double time.

answer.worked: $\begin{align*}\text{Normal pay}&=11.50\times9\\\text{Normal pay}&=\$103.50\\\text{Time-and-a-half pay}&=11.50\times3\times1.5\\\text{Time-and-a-half pay}&=\$51.75\\\text{Double-time pay}&=11.50\times2\times2\\\text{Double-time pay}&=\$46.00\\\text{Total pay}&=103.50+51.75+46.00\\\text{Total pay}&=\$201.25\end{align*}$
